answer: Sorry for your loss. To sell a car you inherited, bring the death certificate plus either court letters naming you executor or administrator of the estate, or, for a small estate that doesn't go through probate court, the heir and estate affidavit (form NW-EST-1) signed by the heir. If there are several heirs, either the executor signs or every heir signs NW-EST-1, and a power of attorney your father signed can't be used because it ended when he died. If there's still a loan on the car, the lender holds the title, and if the car is paid off but the title is lost, you'll need a duplicate title from the state before we can complete the purchase, though you can still get an offer and book an appointment while you wait.
